name: telegram-notify
description: LISTENER for the canonical `solve-captcha` event: turns a hand-off request into ONE standalone Telegram Bot API sendMessage to the operator's chat (no thread, no cause, no kanban coupling). It is one subscriber among potentially several (email/log/other notifiers can be added without touching the solver). Contains no solver logic and no challenge detection.

config_schema.label: Telegram bot token
config_schema.description: Bot token used for the standalone sendMessage call. Reference the secret by name: $secret:TELEGRAM_TOKEN

config_schema.label: Operator chat id
config_schema.description: Chat id the standalone message is sent to. Empty = the listener reports `unavailable` and the solver keeps running.

config_schema.label: send timeout (s)
config_schema.description: HTTP timeout for the sendMessage call.
